headline: Zinc Miners Nexa and Buenaventura Drop as Wall Street Sell-Off Weighs
summary: Shares of zinc mining companies Nexa and Buenaventura dropped following a Wall Street sell-off and falling gold prices, despite steady underlying zinc prices.
why: Nexa Resources and Compañía de Minas Buenaventura are major Latin American base and precious metals producers listed in New York and regional exchanges.

impacts.name: Nexa Resources S.A.
impacts.why: Nexa shares fell alongside broader Wall Street equity weakness and lower gold prices.
